name: SOC Threat Response HQ
tagline: Coordinates SIEM alerts, logs, threat intel, MITRE mapping, containment approval, and post-incident reporting.

orchestrator.job: Triage alerts and routes log investigation, threat intel, detection rules, containment plans, and reports. Blocks containment actions before approval.

agents.job: Ranks alerts by severity, asset criticality, and confidence.
deliverables: Ranks alerts by severity, asset criticality, and confidence

agents.job: Queries logs and reconstructs timeline and scope.
deliverables: Queries logs and reconstructs timeline and scope

agents.job: Maps indicators to MITRE techniques and known campaigns.
deliverables: Maps indicators to MITRE techniques and known campaigns

agents.job: Drafts block, isolate, and rollback plans for approval.
deliverables: Drafts block, isolate, and rollback plans for approval

agents.job: Writes detection/rule updates and regression checks.
deliverables: Writes detection/rule updates and regression checks

reviewGates: Never print private data or secrets
Fall back to safe local drafts on failure
costGuardrails: Use standard or lower for collection and cleanup
Block repeated runs on same input
selfImprovement: Logs run outcomes, failure causes, and user edits into a memory ledger, then updates checklists and eval criteria.

benchmark.selectionRule: highest score, shortest wall time as tie-breaker
